name: Pridewings of Stonetalon
label: Quest
description: Shindrell reports an unconfirmed claim: Concerned about covert Horde attacks, the Sentinels in Astranaar seek to intercept a deadly weapon before it can…

clips.title: The story
paras: Shindrell reports an unconfirmed claim: Concerned about covert Horde attacks, the Sentinels in Astranaar seek to intercept a deadly weapon before it can strike their people. Intelligence from Theramore reveals that orc assassins harvest toxic venom from the wyverns of Stonetalon Mountains for clandestine raids. To protect their fragile border, Alliance scouts are dispatched south to harvest the venom sacs first and starve the enemy of their lethal poison.

Though open war has not been declared between the Alliance and the Horde across northern Kalimdor, the peace between them is razor-thin. Skirmishes break out under thick forest canopies, and quiet, deniable strikes have replaced full-scale armies. Sentinel commanders in Astranaar maintain constant vigilance against covert enemy movements, knowing that complacency could cost them their sanctuary.

Shindrell reports an unconfirmed claim: Intelligence passed from secretive contacts in Theramore brought word of a sinister enterprise underway in the crags of Stonetalon. Orcish stalkers have been gathering venom from wild pridewings around Mirkfallon Lake, using the potent biological agent to coat their blades for fatal ambush raids against Alliance personnel. To blunt the threat, Shindrell Swiftfire directs champions to cull the beasts and seize the venom sacs before Horde agents can harvest them.

Ordering the destruction of native beasts weighs heavily on the night elves, who hold deep reverence for Kalimdor's wilderness. Shindrell herself laments that innocent creatures must suffer for a war they have no role in choosing. Yet in the grim calculus of border defense, denying an enemy lethal arms takes precedence over ecological preservation.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We are not in open war with the Horde, but our peace is fragile. We often find their agents moving against us, but they do so covertly.

One such advance was revealed to us from hidden sources in Theramore, claiming that the orcs collect venom from the pridewings near Mirkfallon Lake, in the Stonetalon Mountains to the south. Orc assassins then use the venom on their secret death raids against the Alliance!
If this is true, then we must stop them, friend. We must deny them their source of venom.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the pridewing venom sacs, friend? We cannot allow the orcs to use the beasts' poisons against us!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. It saddens me to order the slaughter of creatures who may not willingly aid our enemies, yet it is my duty to do so.
Your heart might weep for the pridewings you slew, my friend, but may your heart then swell in knowing that your allies are safe from the pridewings' venom.
